annotations.title: Resolve a vehicle to exact year/make/model

description: Use FIRST whenever the user names a vehicle ('2017 Ford Escape', "'17 F150", 'my Honda Civic') unless you already have exact slugs from a previous call. Pass the user's words in `query`. Returns kind=exact (use the returned slugs), suggest (ask the user to confirm one), needsYear (ask ONE question listing availableYears), needsModel, or notFound (say Wrench.Pro doesn't cover it — never guess).

query.description: Free-text vehicle description, e.g. '2017 ford escape'.

name: resolve_vehicle
title: Resolve a vehicle to exact year/make/model
